title: Returned Payments and the Reconnection Payment — Electric Service Agreement Terms of Service
content:
Under the terms of the Electric Service Agreement, a customer whose payments have recently been returned unpaid pays a returned-payment add-on as part of the reconnection payment.

**Term.** A returned-payment add-on is included in the reconnection payment: five times (5 times) the schedule's returned payment fee when two or more payments on the agreement were reversed as returned unpaid in the 12 calendar months before the payment, two and a half times (2.5 times) that fee when exactly one was, and nothing when none was.

**How it is added.** The add-on is added to the reconnection payment after the basis amount has been rounded to the cent. The payment total is stated rounded to the cent.

**Returns counted.** Payments on the agreement reversed as returned unpaid by the customer's bank. Every count over a stated number of calendar months before a posting takes the records dated less than that many whole calendar months before the posting date.

| Payments reversed as returned unpaid in the 12 calendar months before the payment | Returned-payment add-on |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 5 times the schedule's returned payment fee |
| exactly 1 | 2.5 times the schedule's returned payment fee |
| none | nothing |

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** With a hypothetical returned payment fee of 25.00 USD, one return in the period adds 62.50 USD and two or more add 125.00 USD. With no return, nothing is added.
